reuse.why: Adds the rule to the existing shouldWriteMonthBudgetCategory predicate and uses the existing extractTagsFromText tag parser rather than hand-rolled matching.

duplication.why: The rule itself is in one place, but the same LEFT JOIN notes / group_note column is pasted into six separate category queries instead of consolidating the already-duplicated query.

placement.why: The exclusion lives in the shared month-wide predicate in actions.ts and the tag parsing stays in #shared/tags.

scope.why: Focused on the request plus a test; the type tidy-ups (BudgetData built from MonthBudgetCategory) are related to carrying the new field.

maintainability.why: Easy to own since the rule is centralised, though any future group-level field must again be added to six near-identical SQL strings.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated notes join is copied verbatim across the queries (setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg, getBudgetData), not disguised.

one_place.where: shouldWriteMonthBudgetCategory in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by every month-wide action; each action's query only supplies group_note.
